base_dir.description: Base directory for configuration and runtime files.

min_servers.description: The minimum number of client processes to start.

min_spare_servers.description: The minimum number of client processes that should hang around idle.

max_spare_servers.description: The maximum number of idle processes.

max_servers.description: The absolute maximum number of child processes to start.

max_requests.description: Maximum number of requests per child process before restart.

max_keepalive.description: Number of requests after that mtpolicyd closes the connection or no limit if set to zero.

port.description: Comma separated list of ports to listen on. Format: IP:Port.

request_timeout.description: Maximum total time for one request.

vhost_by_policy_context.description: Select VirtualHost by 'policy_context' request field. Default is 0.

virtual_hosts.description: List of VirtualHost configurations. Each VirtualHost must have a port, name, and at least one Plugin.

session_cache.description: SessionCache configuration block. If not defined, defaults to 'None'.
